resources.string: NotCaD uses this accessibility service exclusively to detect when protected apps are opened outside your scheduled focus session and to guide you safely back home or lock your screen when your designated usage timer expires.
Used solely to lock your device screen when your timer expires, enforcing your productivity commitment.
Infinite feeds are engineered to steal hours without friction. NotCaD puts a secure vault between your impulses and addictive apps.

1. Authenticate with PIN
2. Commit to a fixed timer (5-60m)
3. Finish your task
4. Automatic session termination & screen lock
Persistent timers survive restarts. When time is up, your session ends immediately so you can return to meaningful work.
Enables NotCaD to automatically return to the home screen or lock the device when your usage session expires.
Allows NotCaD to track distraction time and monitor foreground app sessions accurately.
Allows NotCaD to present the full-screen expiration alert when your timer ends.
Provides a persistent real-time countdown notification during active app sessions.
Your session is over. Now put your phone away and get back to work.
